notes: Desktop/rack unit: 1RU, 19" rackmount (not desktop). Data drawn from Tieline's own manual "Gateway 4 Rear Panel Connections" page, the official Gateway specifications table, and the official Gateway 4 product datasheet PDF (labeled rear/front panel diagrams), all on tieline.com / hosted verbatim reseller mirrors. Two ports (the DB-25 Analog/AES3 I/O breakout and the DB-25 Control Port) use a 25-pin D-sub connector that has no matching id in the allowed connector enum; "rs232" (the only D-sub-family id available) was used as the closest approximation for both — flag these if the app does connector/cable-compatibility matching, since they are not literally RS232 serial ports. A supplementary chassis ground terminal (screw stud) also exists on the rear panel but was omitted since it isn't a signal/power connector type in the schema. An optional Euro ISDN module (2 B-channel ISDN, adds ports via the internal module slot) and an optional WheatNet-IP card (reuses the existing AoIP1 RJ45) are purchasable add-ons, not standard physical connectors, so they were not added as separate ports. AoIP Port 2 and USB 3.0 store-and-forward are both marked "future release" in the source datasheet — physically present but not fully functional in early firmware. Grades for RJ45 network ports (LAN1/2, AoIP1/2) set to eth-1g per their stated "Gigabit (10/100/1000)" auto-negotiating spec; the audio-carrying RJ45 jacks (ANALOG/AES3 IN/OUT) intentionally have no grade since they carry analog/AES3 audio, not Ethernet.

ports.name: ANALOG/AES3 IN 1
ports.note: Carries stereo analog line input pair 1-2 or stereo AES3 digital input pair 1-2 (shared/configurable per jack)

ports.name: ANALOG/AES3 IN 2
ports.note: Carries stereo analog line input pair 3-4 or stereo AES3 digital input pair 3-4 (shared/configurable per jack)

ports.name: ANALOG/AES3 OUT 1
ports.note: Carries stereo analog line output pair 1-2 or stereo AES3 digital output pair 1-2 (shared/configurable per jack)

ports.name: ANALOG/AES3 OUT 2
ports.note: Carries stereo analog line output pair 3-4 or stereo AES3 digital output pair 3-4 (shared/configurable per jack)

ports.name: ANALOG/AES3 IN & OUT
ports.note: Actual connector is a Female DB-25 (25-pin D-sub, Tascam pinout) providing 4-channel analog or AES3 I/O; no D-sub audio connector id exists in the allowed list so rs232 (nearest D-sub family id) was used as a placeholder. This DB-25 mirrors the same 4 in / 4 out audio channels available via the RJ45 ANALOG/AES3 IN and OUT jacks (alternate wiring option), not additional channels.

ports.name: SYNC IO 1
ports.note: Configurable as Wordclock, AES3 input, AES11id, PTP sample clock, or fixed

ports.name: SYNC IO 2
ports.note: Configurable as Wordclock, AES3 input, AES11id, PTP sample clock, or fixed

ports.name: CONTROL PORT IO 1-8
ports.note: Actual connector is a Female DB-25 supporting 8 CMOS control inputs and 8 opto-isolated solid-state relay outputs (GPIO), not a serial data port; rs232 used as nearest D-sub family placeholder since no generic D-sub id exists in the allowed list.

ports.name: AoIP 1
ports.note: AES67 / ST 2110-30 / ST 2022-7 or optional WheatNet-IP streaming; auto-negotiating 10/100/1000

ports.name: AoIP 2
ports.note: Present in hardware but listed by Tieline as not operational in early firmware releases / future release

ports.name: LAN1
ports.note: Gigabit (10/100/1000) LAN port for IP streaming over WANs; primary

ports.name: LAN2
ports.note: Gigabit (10/100/1000) LAN port for IP streaming over WANs; backup

ports.name: USB 3.0
ports.note: Rear panel host port; supports record/playback of audio files (store-and-forward listed as future release)

ports.name: RS232
ports.note: Female DB-9 serial port, up to 115kbps, used for local/remote equipment control or in-band data channel

ports.name: USB 2.0
ports.note: Front panel host port; firmware upgrades, Wi-Fi USB modem, memory sticks

ports.name: Headphone Out
ports.note: Front panel 6.35mm (1/4") headphone output with level adjust
